description:
My first love wasn't someone who was affectionate; he was just someone who was nice to everyone.
So I tried not to fall for it this time. Because the second guy I got entangled with was even more blatant. Skilled at handling people, sharing interest and affection just right... Another player! But it's strange. This guy is clearly the same type, yet he can't seem to draw a line with me specifically. He laughs lightly with other girls, but is inexplicably persistent with me. It feels like a joke one moment, an obsession the next; it seems lighthearted yet strangely heavy the next. What is this? Are you stringing me along, or... is this for real? You're rebellious, yet strangely pure-hearted!


**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=849365), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13971615)
